collection.title: Value-Creating Education Literature Review Documents
collection.description: Six research-informed printable documents on Tsunesaburo Makiguchi, Josei Toda, and Daisaku Ikeda, organized for future literature-review and collaboration platforms.

preparedBy.name: Peter Bjork
preparedBy.program: PhD in Value-Creating Education for Global Citizens
preparedBy.display: Prepared by Peter Bjork, M.Ed., DePaul University - College of Education - PhD in Value-Creating Education for Global Citizens

documents.title: Makiguchi’s Ideas in Day-to-Day Education
documents.summary: A classroom translation of Makiguchi’s value-creating pedagogy, including value creation, teacher practice, lesson design, and practical guardrails.

documents.title: Makiguchi: Opposing Ideas and Major Critics
documents.summary: Intellectual alternatives, practical objections, and contested interpretations surrounding Makiguchi’s educational thought and later reception.

documents.title: Josei Toda’s Contributions to Education
documents.summary: An evidence-qualified account of Toda as teacher, methods writer, publisher, organizer, and transmitter of value-creating education.

documents.title: Josei Toda: Criticism and Leading Critics
documents.summary: Educational, textual, religious, organizational, political, and peace-related objections to Toda’s work and legacy.

documents.title: A Secondary School for Value Creation
documents.summary: An evidence-grounded reconstruction of an ideal classroom, lesson, teaching strategy, school day, and institutional culture under Ikeda’s philosophy.

documents.title: Non-Examples of an Ikeda Classroom
documents.summary: A visual field guide to classroom practices that contradict dignity, dialogue, wisdom, contribution, and nonsectarian human education.
